title: PAR-58/7K EED 32,768-byte version matrix fast slice

researchBasis.reportedFailure: ACadSharp's EED per-APPID length narrowed to signed short for a 32,768-byte payload on AC1015, AC1018, and AC1032.
researchBasis.evidenceCeiling: Peer issue report, not a DWG size limit or independent format oracle.

behavior: Generate an exact 32,768 encoded-byte APPID EED payload using legacy codepage strings for AC1015/AC1018 and UTF-16 text-area strings for AC1021/AC1032.
Measure generated item sizes through dwgBufferW::encodeTextAreaString under the version-specific encoding partition.
Independently walk the raw envelope for unsigned chunk length, APPID handle, terminator, and following-field cursor; structurally cross-check all EED items with the local reader.
Preserve existing AC1021 32,767/32,768/65,535/65,536 boundary, split, and indivisible-item refusal/retry controls.

limitations: The local writer and reader are structural self-checks, not independent interoperability evidence.
No wall-clock benchmark was run; test coverage does not promote a support claim.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty and repository Git metadata is read-only; this slice is uncommitted.
nextReadinessSlice: Audit transformed-string and length-bearing DXF output controls implicated by LibreDWG #1408/#1412; add generated coverage only for a concrete uncovered invariant, otherwise continue to the next local source-backed parity item.
